name: Session Wrap
description: Produce a rich end-of-session Obsidian note — what was done, why, patterns implemented, and codebase knowledge gained — then hand off to chronicle-docs to format and store it. TRIGGER when: user asks to wrap up the session, write session notes, "document what we did", or "capture this session" before finishing. DO NOT TRIGGER for: general documentation not tied to this session (use chronicle-docs directly).
